# CLAUDE.md — generated REST client

Everything under this directory (`api/`, `model/`, and the support files here) is
auto-generated and carries a header saying so, e.g.:

```
NOTE: This class is auto generated by OpenAPI Generator (https://openapi-generator.tech).
Do not edit the class manually.
```

It's generated from the live OpenAPI spec via:

```
mvn -P openapi-gen generate-sources
```

with the backend running (the plugin fetches the spec from the running server).

**Claude must never hand-edit these generated files.** If backend API changes (new
endpoints, new query params, new DTO fields) require the client to be regenerated:

1. Make the backend changes only.
2. Tell the user the client is now out of sync and needs regeneration, and give them
   the exact command to run (`mvn -P openapi-gen generate-sources` with the backend up).
3. Do not attempt to simulate the generator's output by editing a generated file by
   hand, even "in the same generated style" — this drifts from what the real generator
   would produce and the user will not know regeneration is still owed.
4. Leave the generated files untouched; let the user run the real regeneration and
   review the resulting diff themselves.
